notes: Run each eval against a scratch copy of the repo (pyproject.toml, Makefile, configs/, scripts/, src/mcp-servers/_common, docs/scenario-format.md), never the real src/. Shared assertions apply to every eval that generates code. Results: docs/revamp/skill-evals.md.

shared_assertions.name: english_llm_text
shared_assertions.criterion: Tool docstrings, Field descriptions and client-facing error messages are English (Hangul only allowed in comments, module docstrings, logs, README)

shared_assertions.name: registry_entries
shared_assertions.criterion: configs/mcp_servers.yaml gains <kebab> (stdio, command with --transport stdio) and <kebab>-http (streamable_http url) entries, each with English description and Korean description_ko; existing entries unchanged

shared_assertions.name: ruff_clean
shared_assertions.command: ruff check src/mcp-servers/<snake> tests/<snake> && ruff format --check src/mcp-servers/<snake> tests/<snake>

evals.name: code-repo-3tools-reference-spec
evals.prompt: .claude/skills/mcp-spec-writer/references/example_code_repo.md 정의서를 보고 MCP 서버를 구현해 줘.
evals.expected_output: src/mcp-servers/code_repo_mcp/ 생성. Tool 3개라 tools.py 단일 파일(함수 + TOOLS + register_tools). server.py는 lifespan + --transport(기본 http, 스펙 §4.1 Streamable HTTP) + HTTP 분기 build_http_middleware. client.py는 BackendClient Protocol + MockBackendClient(§5.2 출력 예시 그대로) + HttpBackendClient(NotImplementedError + TODO). get_file_content는 mask_pii 후 wrap_untrusted. 한국어 LLM Description과 에러 메시지를 영어로 옮기고 [CODE] 태그. §4.2 엔드포인트와 인증이 '확인 필요'라 Phase 3 질문 또는 TODO(스펙 미정: ...) 마커. tests/code_repo_mcp/ (conftest, test_tools, test_mcp_contract, test_auth_middleware) + tests/scenarios/code-repo-mcp.yaml. 레지스트리 code-repo-mcp, code-repo-mcp-http. Makefile run-/test-/test-scenarios-code-repo-mcp.

assertions.name: three_tools
assertions.criterion: test_mcp_contract expects exactly list_repositories, get_file_content, search_code

evals.name: sales-dw-3tools-small-spec
evals.expected_output: src/mcp-servers/sales_dw_mcp/ 생성. Tool 3개라 tools.py 단일 파일. REST 백엔드, Bearer 인증, 기본 transport는 stdio(--transport 기본값 stdio, http도 지원). MockBackendClient가 list_datasets/describe_dataset/sample_rows 응답을 §5.2 예시대로 반환. sample_rows 결과 문자열은 mask_pii 적용. 레지스트리 sales-dw-mcp(stdio)와 sales-dw-mcp-http.

assertions.name: three_tools
assertions.criterion: list_datasets, describe_dataset, sample_rows registered with read-only hints

evals.name: incomplete-spec-triggers-askuserquestion
evals.prompt: .claude/skills/mcp-server-builder/evals/fixtures/partial-meta-mcp_v0.1.md 보고 MCP 서버 구현. 정보가 부족하면 물어봐.
evals.expected_output: Transport, 백엔드 프로토콜, 인증 방식, MCP 인증이 모두 '확인 필요'인 스펙. Phase 3에서 AskUserQuestion 한 번에 최대 4개(Transport > MCP 인증 > 프로토콜 > 백엔드 인증)를 묻는다. 답이 없거나 'TODO'면 기본값(http, REST, Bearer, 인증 미들웨어는 MCP_API_KEY로 on/off) + # TODO(스펙 미정: ...) 마커를 넣고 Mock으로 끝까지 동작. 비대화형 실행이면 질문 내용을 요약에 적고 같은 기본값으로 진행.

assertions.name: questions_batched
assertions.criterion: Exactly one batched AskUserQuestion (or, non-interactive, one listed question batch) with at most 4 items in the documented priority order

assertions.name: mock_default
assertions.criterion: Backend URL setting defaults to empty string so MockBackendClient is used; no fake URL placeholder

evals.name: multi-backend-spec
evals.prompt: .claude/skills/mcp-server-builder/evals/fixtures/order-ops-mcp_v0.1.md 정의서로 구현해 줘. Oracle + REST 두 백엔드 연동.
evals.expected_output: src/mcp-servers/order_ops_mcp/ 생성. client.py에 백엔드별 Protocol + Mock + 실 클라이언트 두 쌍(Oracle용, REST용). state.py AppState에 백엔드 필드 두 개와 getter 두 개. config.py에 백엔드별 env 키 분리(<snake>_db_*, <snake>_api_*). server.py lifespan이 둘 다 열고 닫음. Oracle 드라이버는 uv sync --extra oracle 안내 (pyproject 의존성 편집 없음).

assertions.name: two_backends_in_state
assertions.criterion: state.py holds two backend fields with separate getters; lifespan opens and closes both

assertions.name: separate_env_keys
assertions.criterion: config.py and .env.example have distinct keys for the Oracle DSN/credentials and the REST API URL/token

assertions.name: oracle_extra_hint
assertions.criterion: Summary or README tells the user to run `uv sync --extra oracle` instead of editing dependencies

evals.name: english-spec-input
evals.expected_output: English-heading spec is accepted (no rejection). src/mcp-servers/catalog_mcp/ with tools.py (2 tools). LLM Description, Field descriptions, and error messages copied verbatim from the English spec with [CODE] tags. HttpBackendClient sends the X-API-Key header, timeout default 3 s from §7. get_entity returns metadata/untrusted_content with mask_pii on the description. Progress and summary in English. Registry catalog-mcp and catalog-mcp-http.

assertions.name: english_headings_accepted
assertions.criterion: The skill did not reject the spec for missing Korean headings

assertions.name: verbatim_llm_description
assertions.pattern: Search the metadata catalog for tables and dashboards
